hypothesis: Adding per-stage pipeline latency logging, semantic query caching (cosine threshold 0.92, 24h TTL, LRU-500), and page-number-aware chunk metadata will: (1) provide microsecond-resolution profiling without measurable overhead (<0.5ms), (2) eliminate redundant LLM calls for semantically similar queries (>60% cache hit rate under typical usage), (3) enable page-specific citations in generated answers. Zero regression on retrieval metrics (HitRate, MRR, nDCG) and generation quality (Claim Support, Abstention Accuracy).

pipeline_timer.description: Per-stage microsecond-resolution timing via RagPipelineTimer class

semantic_cache.description: Two-tier query cache: exact string match + cosine similarity (threshold 0.92)
semantic_cache.invalidation: Automatic on corpus version bump (ingestMaterial, deleteMaterialChunks)

page_tracking.description: PDF page number tracking in chunk metadata for precise citations

ground_truth_benchmark.description: Offline retrieval quality benchmark against SQLite vector store

hardware.new_vram_overhead: 0 MB (all new features are CPU-only SQLite + PHP)

acceptance_criteria: Zero regression on HitRate@1, HitRate@3, HitRate@5 across Golden, Adversarial, Cross-Module suites
Zero regression on MRR and nDCG@5
Zero regression on Abstention Accuracy (must remain 100%)
Semantic cache hit rate > 60% on repeated query patterns
Cache hit latency < 50ms (vs ~1800ms for full pipeline)
Page metadata present in chunk metadata JSON for page-marked documents
